label: Some candidate is CONCRETE_6 and exists at the selected world w₀…, by Existential elimination and…
rule: Existential elimination and introduction, conjunction elimination
meaning: Assembly (a weakening, not a substantive derivation): the contingency node's witness is concrete and exists at w, so the route's population node holds. It puts the node on the root path as an alternative derivation of STMT-COGITO-INHABITED-CONCRETE-WORLD; as an assembly it closes that node only if the contingency node is closed (invariant 16 fixpoint). It is registered as a strengthens relation (strong: the contingency node; weak: the population node); since 2026-11-12 a registration still counts for reach, so the node stays on the root path, while closure sets the argument aside and closes the weak version only by strength-order propagation. The converse is not certified: CONTINGENT-NODE-CONTROLS shows only that no being is contingent on the one-world frame; that this frame's world is inhabited is not part of the checked statement.
